newsitem.title: UK: Arjo Wiggins names Beylier chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Arjo Wiggins names Beylier chief executive.

text.p: Anglo-French paper and packaging group Arjo Wiggins Appleton Plc said on Wednesday it named former managing director Philippe Beylier as its chief executive following Daniel Melin's resignation last week.
The company also said it was seeking a successor to chairman Cob Stenham, who turned 65 in January.
Stenham agreed to continue as chairman until the end of September 1997, the company said in a statement.
Arjo also said director Dale Schumaker, chairman of its North American subsidiary, had retired.
He will be succeeded on the board by Richard Curwen, currently CEO of the subsidiary, Appleton Papers Inc.
